notes:
Notes: click a note to get a properties bar like Bluebeam's text box.
Line: colour, opacity, style (Solid, Dashed 1 to 6, Cloud) and width.
Fill: colour or None, and opacity.
Font: Helvetica, Times New Roman or Courier New, size, text colour, Bold, Italic, Underline and Strikethrough.
Export PDF for Bluebeam writes notes as Bluebeam text boxes with these settings.
Claude can set the same options on its notes.
